description: This file contains unit tests for the UserRoleManagerService class in the OrangeHRM project. It verifies the behavior of getting and instantiating user role manager classes, including handling invalid or missing classes, and ensures proper exception handling when prerequisites are not met.

classes.name: InvalidUserRoleManager
classes.description: A dummy class that does not extend AbstractUserRoleManager used for testing invalid class handling.

classes.name: UnitTestUserRoleManager
classes.description: A mock implementation extending AbstractUserRoleManager used for unit testing the UserRoleManagerService.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test case.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerClassName
methods.description: Verifies that the service correctly retrieves the class name of the user role manager from configuration.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerExistingClass
methods.description: Tests retrieval and instantiation of an existing valid user role manager class.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerInvalidClass
methods.description: Checks that the service throws an exception when the configured class does not extend the correct base class.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerNonExistingClass
methods.description: Ensures that the service throws an exception when the configured class does not exist.

methods.name: testGetUserRoleManagerNoLoggedInUser
methods.description: Verifies that an exception is thrown if there is no logged-in user when attempting to get the user role manager.
